title: Algebra of sets
primary_statement: unions, intersections, complements, De Morgan, indexed families (from math-sets)

title: Preimage algebra
primary_statement: f^-1 commutes with union, intersection, complement (from math-sets)

title: Countable set
primary_statement: injects into N; countable unions of countable sets are countable (from math-sets)

title: R as a complete ordered field
primary_statement: the least-upper-bound property and its consequences (from math-real-analysis)

title: Convergence of a real sequence
primary_statement: epsilon-N convergence, algebra of limits, squeeze (from math-real-analysis)

title: limsup and liminf
primary_statement: limsup A_n = intersection of tails; for sets, {omega in infinitely many A_n}

title: Convergence of a real series
primary_statement: partial sums, comparison, absolute convergence (from math-real-analysis)

title: Convex function
primary_statement: f(tx+(1-t)y) <= t f(x)+(1-t)f(y); supporting line at every interior point

title: Lebesgue integral against a measure
primary_statement: integral of f dmu for measurable f >= 0, then integrable f (CITED, not built)

title: Monotone convergence theorem
primary_statement: 0<=f_n up f  =>  integral f_n up integral f (CITED)

title: Dominated convergence theorem
primary_statement: f_n -> f pointwise, |f_n|<=g integrable  =>  integral f_n -> integral f (CITED)

title: Fatou's lemma
primary_statement: integral of liminf f_n <= liminf integral f_n for f_n >= 0 (CITED)

title: Fubini-Tonelli theorem
primary_statement: iterated integrals equal the product integral (nonneg, or integrable) (CITED)

title: Radon-Nikodym theorem
primary_statement: nu << mu, sigma-finite  =>  nu has a density dnu/dmu w.r.t. mu (CITED)

title: Sigma-algebra
primary_statement: a family of subsets closed under complement and countable union, containing Omega

title: Generated sigma-algebra
primary_statement: sigma(C) is the smallest sigma-algebra containing the collection C

title: Borel sigma-algebra on R
primary_statement: B(R) = sigma(open intervals); the events a real random variable can produce

title: Measurable space
primary_statement: a pair (Omega, F) with F a sigma-algebra on Omega

title: Measure
primary_statement: mu: F -> [0, infinity], mu(empty)=0, countably additive on disjoint unions

title: pi-lambda (Dynkin) theorem
primary_statement: a lambda-system containing a pi-system contains the sigma-algebra it generates

title: Lebesgue measure via Caratheodory
primary_statement: the outer-measure / Caratheodory extension gives Lebesgue measure on B(R) (CITED)

title: Monotonicity and subadditivity of a measure
primary_statement: A subset B => mu(A) <= mu(B); mu(union A_n) <= sum mu(A_n)

title: Continuity of a measure
primary_statement: A_n up A => mu(A_n) -> mu(A); A_n down A with mu(A_1)<inf => mu(A_n) -> mu(A)

title: Null set
primary_statement: N in F with mu(N) = 0; a property holds almost everywhere if it fails only on a null set

title: Almost surely (a.s.)
primary_statement: an event of probability 1; "P-a.s." = "outside a P-null set"

title: Kolmogorov axioms
primary_statement: P >= 0 ; P(Omega) = 1 ; P is countably additive on disjoint events

title: Probability measure
primary_statement: a measure P on (Omega, F) with P(Omega) = 1

title: Probability space
primary_statement: a triple (Omega, F, P) satisfying the Kolmogorov axioms

title: Complement and monotonicity of P
primary_statement: P(A^c) = 1 - P(A) ; A subset B => P(A) <= P(B) ; P(A) in [0,1]

title: Finite additivity of P
primary_statement: pairwise disjoint A_1..A_n => P(union) = sum P(A_i)  (from countable additivity)

title: Inclusion-exclusion
primary_statement: P(union A_i) = sum P(A_i) - sum P(A_i cap A_j) + ...

title: Boole's inequality (union bound)
primary_statement: P(union A_n) <= sum P(A_n)

title: Continuity of probability
primary_statement: A_n up A => P(A_n) -> P(A) ; A_n down A => P(A_n) -> P(A)

title: First Borel-Cantelli lemma
primary_statement: sum P(A_n) < infinity  =>  P(A_n infinitely often) = 0

title: Second Borel-Cantelli lemma
primary_statement: A_n independent and sum P(A_n) = infinity  =>  P(A_n infinitely often) = 1

title: Conditional probability
primary_statement: P(A | B) = P(A cap B) / P(B) when P(B) > 0

title: Multiplication / chain rule
primary_statement: P(A cap B) = P(A|B) P(B) ; P(cap A_i) = prod P(A_i | earlier)

title: Law of total probability
primary_statement: {B_i} a partition, P(B_i)>0  =>  P(A) = sum P(A|B_i) P(B_i)

title: Bayes' theorem
primary_statement: P(B_j | A) = P(A|B_j) P(B_j) / sum_i P(A|B_i) P(B_i)

title: Measurable function
primary_statement: f^-1(B) in F for every B in the target sigma-algebra

title: Random variable
primary_statement: a measurable function X: (Omega,F) -> (R, B(R)) (or R^d, B(R^d))

title: Indicator random variable
primary_statement: 1_A(omega) = 1 if omega in A else 0 ; measurable iff A in F ; E[1_A] = P(A)

title: Distribution (law) of a random variable
primary_statement: P_X = P compose X^-1, a probability measure on (R, B(R))

title: Cumulative distribution function
primary_statement: F_X(x) = P(X <= x)

title: Characterization of a CDF
primary_statement: F nondecreasing, right-continuous, F(-inf)=0, F(+inf)=1 ; every such F is some law

title: A CDF determines the law
primary_statement: F_X = F_Y  =>  P_X = P_Y  (pi-lambda on the half-lines)

title: Discrete random variable
primary_statement: X takes values in a countable set

title: Probability mass function
primary_statement: p_X(x) = P(X = x) ; sums to 1 over the support

title: Absolutely continuous random variable
primary_statement: P_X << Lebesgue measure

title: Probability density function
primary_statement: f_X = dP_X/dLebesgue ; P(X in B) = integral_B f_X ; f_X >= 0, integrates to 1

title: Quantile function
primary_statement: F_X^-1(u) = inf { x : F_X(x) >= u }, the generalized inverse

title: Probability integral transform
primary_statement: F continuous => F(X) ~ Uniform(0,1) ; and F^-1(U) has law F  (the simulation bridge)

title: Univariate change of variables
primary_statement: Y = g(X), g monotone C^1 => f_Y(y) = f_X(g^-1(y)) |d/dy g^-1(y)|

title: Multivariate change of variables
primary_statement: Y = g(X), g a diffeomorphism => f_Y(y) = f_X(g^-1(y)) |det J_{g^-1}(y)|

title: Joint distribution
primary_statement: the law of the random vector (X_1,...,X_n) on (R^n, B(R^n))

title: Marginal distribution
primary_statement: the law of a subvector, obtained by integrating out the others

title: Conditional distribution
primary_statement: f_{Y|X}(y|x) = f_{X,Y}(x,y) / f_X(x) where f_X(x) > 0

title: Independence of events
primary_statement: P(cap_{i in S} A_i) = prod_{i in S} P(A_i) for every finite S (mutual)

title: Independence of sigma-algebras
primary_statement: P(A cap B) = P(A)P(B) for all A in G_1, B in G_2

title: Independence of random variables
primary_statement: the generated sigma-algebras are independent ; equivalently the joint law is a product

title: Factorization criterion for independence
primary_statement: X,Y independent iff F_{X,Y} = F_X F_Y iff (densities) f_{X,Y} = f_X f_Y

title: Pairwise independence is weaker than mutual
primary_statement: three events pairwise independent but not mutually independent (two fair coins, XOR)

title: Independent and identically distributed
primary_statement: (X_n) mutually independent and all with the same law

title: Convolution for a sum of independents
primary_statement: X,Y independent => f_{X+Y}(z) = integral f_X(x) f_Y(z-x) dx  (sum in the discrete case)

title: Expectation
primary_statement: E[X] = integral X dP, defined when E[|X|] < infinity (or X >= 0)

title: Law of the unconscious statistician
primary_statement: E[g(X)] = integral g dP_X = sum g(x) p_X(x) = integral g(x) f_X(x) dx

title: Linearity of expectation
primary_statement: E[aX + bY] = a E[X] + b E[Y]  (no independence needed)

title: Jensen's inequality
primary_statement: phi convex, E[|X|]<inf  =>  phi(E[X]) <= E[phi(X)]

title: Variance
primary_statement: Var(X) = E[(X - E[X])^2], defined when E[X^2] < infinity

title: Variance under an affine map
primary_statement: Var(aX + b) = a^2 Var(X)

title: Covariance
primary_statement: Cov(X,Y) = E[(X-E[X])(Y-E[Y])] = E[XY] - E[X]E[Y]

title: Bilinearity of covariance
primary_statement: Cov is symmetric bilinear ; Cov(X,X) = Var(X)

title: Correlation coefficient
primary_statement: rho(X,Y) = Cov(X,Y) / (sd(X) sd(Y)) ; |rho| <= 1 by Cauchy-Schwarz

title: Variance of a sum
primary_statement: Var(sum X_i) = sum Var(X_i) + 2 sum_{i<j} Cov(X_i, X_j)

title: Expectation factorizes under independence
primary_statement: X,Y independent and integrable  =>  E[XY] = E[X] E[Y] ; hence Cov = 0

title: Uncorrelated does not imply independent
primary_statement: X ~ Uniform(-1,1), Y = X^2 : Cov(X,Y) = 0 but Y is a function of X

title: Moments and central moments
primary_statement: m_k = E[X^k] ; mu_k = E[(X - E[X])^k] ; skewness, kurtosis

title: L^p space of random variables
primary_statement: L^p(P) = { X : E[|X|^p] < infinity }, norm ||X||_p = E[|X|^p]^{1/p}

title: Nesting of L^p spaces
primary_statement: on a probability space, p > q >= 1  =>  ||X||_q <= ||X||_p , so L^p subset L^q

title: Moment generating function
primary_statement: M_X(t) = E[e^{tX}], where it is finite on a neighborhood of 0

title: Moments from the MGF
primary_statement: M_X finite near 0 => M_X is C^infinity there and M_X^{(k)}(0) = E[X^k]

title: MGF determines the law
primary_statement: M_X = M_Y finite on a neighborhood of 0  =>  P_X = P_Y

title: Characteristic function
primary_statement: phi_X(t) = E[e^{i t X}] ; always exists, |phi_X| <= 1, phi_X(0) = 1

title: Properties of the characteristic function
primary_statement: uniformly continuous ; phi determines the law (inversion) ; phi_{aX+b}(t) = e^{itb} phi_X(at)

title: MGF / CF of a sum of independents
primary_statement: X,Y independent  =>  M_{X+Y} = M_X M_Y  and  phi_{X+Y} = phi_X phi_Y

title: Chernoff bound
primary_statement: P(X >= a) <= inf_{t>0} e^{-ta} M_X(t)  (Markov applied to e^{tX})

title: Hoeffding's inequality
primary_statement: X_i independent in [a_i,b_i]  =>  P(S - E[S] >= s) <= exp(-2 s^2 / sum (b_i-a_i)^2)

title: Bernoulli distribution
primary_statement: P(X=1)=p, P(X=0)=1-p ; E=p, Var=p(1-p) ; MGF (1-p)+p e^t

title: Binomial distribution
primary_statement: sum of n iid Bernoulli(p) ; P(X=k)=C(n,k)p^k(1-p)^{n-k} ; E=np, Var=np(1-p)

title: Geometric distribution
primary_statement: P(X=k)=(1-p)^{k-1}p ; E=1/p, Var=(1-p)/p^2 ; memoryless

title: Poisson distribution
primary_statement: P(X=k)=e^{-lambda} lambda^k / k! ; E=Var=lambda ; MGF exp(lambda(e^t-1))

title: Poisson limit (law of rare events)
primary_statement: Binomial(n, lambda/n) -> Poisson(lambda) as n -> infinity

title: Exponential distribution
primary_statement: f(x)=lambda e^{-lambda x}, x>=0 ; E=1/lambda, Var=1/lambda^2 ; memoryless

title: Memorylessness
primary_statement: P(X > s+t | X > s) = P(X > t) ; characterizes geometric (discrete) and exponential (continuous)

title: Gamma distribution
primary_statement: f(x) prop x^{k-1} e^{-x/theta} ; sum of k iid Exponential ; E=k theta, Var=k theta^2

title: Beta distribution
primary_statement: f(x) prop x^{a-1}(1-x)^{b-1} on [0,1] ; conjugate prior for a Bernoulli rate

title: Normal (Gaussian) distribution
primary_statement: f(x) = (1/(sigma sqrt(2 pi))) exp(-(x-mu)^2/(2 sigma^2)) ; E=mu, Var=sigma^2

title: Standard normal
primary_statement: Z ~ N(0,1) ; CF exp(-t^2/2) ; Z = (X - mu)/sigma

title: Normals are closed under affine maps and sums
primary_statement: aX+b ~ N(a mu + b, a^2 sigma^2) ; independent normals sum to a normal

title: Cauchy distribution has no mean
primary_statement: f(x) = 1/(pi(1+x^2)) : E[|X|] = infinity, so the LLN and CLT both fail

title: Almost sure convergence
primary_statement: P( X_n -> X ) = 1  (convergence mode tag: a.s.)

title: Convergence in probability
primary_statement: for all eps > 0, P(|X_n - X| > eps) -> 0  (mode tag: p)

title: Convergence in L^p
primary_statement: E[|X_n - X|^p] -> 0  (mode tag: L^p)

title: Convergence in distribution
primary_statement: F_{X_n}(x) -> F_X(x) at every continuity point of F_X  (mode tag: d)

title: Lattice of convergence modes
primary_statement: a.s. => p ; L^p => p ; p => d ; p => a.s. subsequence ; d to a constant => p ; none reverse in general

title: Portmanteau theorem
primary_statement: X_n -> X in distribution iff E[g(X_n)] -> E[g(X)] for all bounded continuous g (and 3 more forms)

title: Continuous mapping theorem
primary_statement: X_n -> X (a.s. / p / d) and g continuous on a set of P_X-measure 1 => g(X_n) -> g(X) in the same mode

title: Slutsky's theorem
primary_statement: X_n -> X in d, Y_n -> c in p  =>  X_n + Y_n -> X + c and X_n Y_n -> cX in d

title: Weak law of large numbers
primary_statement: X_i iid, E|X_1| < inf  =>  sample mean -> E[X_1] in probability  (mode tag: p)

title: Strong law of large numbers
primary_statement: X_i iid, E|X_1| < inf  =>  sample mean -> E[X_1] almost surely  (mode tag: a.s.)

title: Levy's continuity theorem
primary_statement: phi_{X_n}(t) -> phi(t) for all t, phi continuous at 0  =>  X_n -> X in distribution (CITED)

title: Central limit theorem (i.i.d.)
primary_statement: X_i iid, mean mu, var sigma^2 in (0,inf)  =>  sqrt(n)(mean - mu)/sigma -> N(0,1) in distribution (CITED)

title: Lindeberg central limit theorem
primary_statement: independent, not identically distributed ; the Lindeberg condition  =>  normalized sum -> N(0,1) (CITED)

title: Delta method
primary_statement: sqrt(n)(T_n - theta) -> N(0,sigma^2), g differentiable  =>  sqrt(n)(g(T_n)-g(theta)) -> N(0, g'(theta)^2 sigma^2)

title: Elementary conditional expectation
primary_statement: E[X | Y = y] = sum x p_{X|Y}(x|y)  (or the density analogue)

title: Conditional expectation given a sigma-algebra
primary_statement: E[X | G] is the a.s.-unique G-measurable Z with integral_A Z = integral_A X for all A in G

title: Existence of conditional expectation
primary_statement: X integrable  =>  E[X|G] exists and is a.s. unique (Radon-Nikodym, or L^2 projection then extend) (CITED)

title: Tower property / law of total expectation
primary_statement: H subset G  =>  E[ E[X|G] | H ] = E[X|H] ; in particular E[E[X|G]] = E[X]

title: Law of total variance
primary_statement: Var(X) = E[ Var(X|G) ] + Var( E[X|G] )

title: Conditional expectation as the L^2 best predictor
primary_statement: for X in L^2, E[X|G] minimizes E[(X - Z)^2] over G-measurable Z

title: Martingale
primary_statement: E[X_{n+1} | F_n] = X_n ; the doorway to stochastic processes (STATED, not developed)

title: Stochastic process
primary_statement: a family (X_t) of random variables on one probability space (STATED, not developed)

title: Kolmogorov extension theorem
primary_statement: consistent finite-dimensional laws determine a process on the product space (STATED, CITED)
